context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature (silent scrape failures + Push Notifications sidebar removal) is fully working. The single feature-relevant failure in test_notifications_scope (TestKeepNewOrderAndLowStock) is a pre-existing pagination race caused by /api/notifications capping at 50, NOT caused by this change. Other backend test failures (test_ebay_category_api, test_scrape_e2e_stock_status, test_product_code) are pre-existing xdist/motor flakes tracked in earlier iterations.
rca of the issue: TestKeepNewOrderAndLowStock: /api/notifications endpoint has default limit=50. When more than 50 notifications exist, adding one new one pushes an older one off the list, so count-diff comparisons can yield a delta of 0 or −1 instead of +1. Mitigation: fetch with a larger limit (e.g. ?limit=200) or filter by type via query param, or use a database-count endpoint. Not related to the current feature change.
